description: The Bitcompare Stablecoin Yield Index: the median USDT or USDC lending rate across providers (one vote each), overall and split CeFi/DeFi, stored once per UTC day. A segment with too few providers (5 overall, 3 per split) is null with nullReason, never a thin number. reconstructed = rebuilt from stored history; provisional = the day is still being recomputed. CC BY 4.0: credit "Source: Bitcompare Stablecoin Yield Index". Returns every snapshot stored for one day with its frozen constituents (each provider, its rate, platform type and why it was left out, if it was): the citable print for that date. 404 when nothing is stored for the day.

segment.description: Only this segment. Default: all three.

name: stablecoin_yield_index_day

final.description: True when every snapshot for the day is final

minProviders.description: Votes needed before the segment prints

provisional.description: Still being recomputed; final days never change

reconstructed.description: Rebuilt from stored history after the fact

value.description: Segment median rate (%), or null below the provider minimum

title: Bitcompare Stablecoin Yield Index (one day)
